title: Capricorn Zodiac Sign: Personality, Love, Career & Compatibility
intro: Capricorn (December 22 – January 19) is the ambitious earth sign ruled by Saturn. Disciplined, wise and quietly funny, Capricorn climbs steadily toward its goals.
personality: Capricorn plays the long game. Responsible and patient, they set clear goals and work step by step until they get there. They value respect, tradition and results. Serious at first sight, they have a dry sense of humor that close friends adore. They often grow more relaxed and playful with age.
love: Capricorn looks for a serious, loyal partner to build a future with. They show love through commitment, stability and keeping promises. Once they trust, they are steady and devoted.
career: Capricorn excels in management, business, finance, law, engineering, government and any field with a clear ladder to climb.
friendship: Capricorn friends are few but forever: dependable, wise and always ready with practical help.

faq.q: What is the Capricorn personality like?
faq.ans: Capricorn is ambitious, disciplined, responsible and practical.

faq.q: Who is Capricorn most compatible with?
faq.ans: Capricorn tends to match best with Taurus, Virgo and Scorpio.
Capricorn is ruled by Saturn, the planet of discipline and time.
